defect_assertion: deepEqual is a hand-rolled reimplementation of deep equality instead of Node's built-in util.isDeepStrictEqual, and it is not just redundant but subtly wrong: it compares only each object's own enumerable keys via Object.keys(), so a type like Date stores its actual value outside of any own enumerable property, meaning two different Date instances (both with zero own enumerable keys) are incorrectly reported as equal even when their real values differ.
